newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea won ends little higher, early loss erased.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea won ends little higher, early loss erased.

text.p: The won closed slightly higher versus the dollar on Monday as month-end export deals more than recouped the early loss, traders said.
The won ended at 891.50, compared with Friday's closing of 891.70. It opened at 892.50 and traded in a range of 890.90 to 892.80.

The won weakened in early morning, pressured by the dollar's rise against the Japanese yen in the world markets, traders said. However, banks started selling dollars in late morning on heavy dollar positions and export settlements.
Dealers said the won was seen trading between 890-893 on Tuesday with a mid-rate of 891.90. Today's mid-rate was pegged at 891.40.
